parameters.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM customers
  WHERE customer_id = $1
    AND lower(security_answer) = lower(trim($2))
),
recent AS (
  SELECT ticket_id, priority, created_at
  FROM tickets
  WHERE category = $3
    AND (
      customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM c)
      OR ((SELECT customer_id FROM c) IS NULL
          AND $7 <> ''
          AND description LIKE '%[Caller phone: ' || $7 || ']%')
    )
    AND status <> 'resolved'
    AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO tickets (customer_id, category, priority, description, source)
  SELECT
    (SELECT customer_id FROM c),
    $3,
    $4,
    $5
      || CASE WHEN (SELECT customer_id FROM c) IS NULL
              THEN ' [UNVERIFIED CALLER. Customer ID given: ' || coalesce(nullif($1, ''), 'none') || ']'
              ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN $7 <> '' THEN ' [Caller phone: ' || $7 || ']' ELSE '' END,
    'voice_agent'
  WHERE $6 = 'yes'
    AND length(trim($5)) > 0
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recent)
  RETURNING ticket_id, priority, description, created_at
)
SELECT
  (SELECT customer_id FROM c) AS verified_customer,
  (SELECT row_to_json(recent) FROM recent) AS recent,
  (SELECT row_to_json(inserted) FROM inserted) AS inserted;
